content: 1. IA will consist of the following components (30 marks):
a. Assignments (20 Marks): Students will prepare three oral assignments.
a. (Term End Simulation): Students will carry out simulated tasks at the
end of the semester. It would comprise individual and group tasks.
3. Viva (25 Marks): Viva will be conducted at the end of the semester. It will be
based on the CSE, Term Work, Assignments and topics covered in the syllabus.
a. (Term-End Presentation): Students will make a presentation based on
topics provided by the faculty, at the end of the semester.
Siddons Suzy. The Complete Presentation Skills Handbook. Kogan Page, 2008.
